description:
Browse or search the item catalogue. One page of live items (seasonal, obsolete and unreleased items are excluded from browsing but still
resolve by shortname). Each result carries `shortname`, `display_name`, `category`, `icon_url` and
`is_craftable`; fetch `/items/{shortname}` for everything else. Same ordering and cache as the /items page
on the site (15 minutes).

category.description: Restrict to one of the 14 wiki.facepunch.com item categories.

search.description: Fuzzy name search: substring match plus trigram similarity, so a typo like `asault` still finds the Assault Rifle. Results are ranked by similarity unless `sort=category`.

sort.description: `name` = alphabetical (similarity-ranked while searching); `category` = grouped by category, then name.

name: browse_items
title: Browse or search the item catalogue
